row.body: The room key is marked returned before the airport pickup arrived; a water bottle is tagged for a guest whose name is missing from the ledger.
row.title: Airport room turnover

sidecar.gloss: A room turns over before its guest’s pickup.
sidecar.rival_reading: A delayed guest could leave the same gap; the ledger does not show why the pickup ran late.

row.body: four notches on the toothbrush match four marks on the bath towel; a fifth mark was sanded flat on both.
row.title: missing count beside the toothbrush

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
